study: The value of the optimal rule

configuration.fit: TMLE(learned_rule=LearnedRule(), estimands=['ey_optimal_rule'], n_folds=10, cv_evaluation=True, targeting_scheme='pooled', g_bounds='auto', random_state=<fold seed>); every other setting the constructor's default; repeats=1
configuration.known_g: fit(..., treatment_probabilities=[1 - g0(1 | W), g0(1 | W)]) with logit g0(1 | W) = 0.3 W1 - 0.2 W2, in every cell but the estimated-g one
configuration.outcome_learner: Pipeline(PolynomialFeatures(2, interaction_only=True, include_bias=False), LogisticRegression(C=1e6, max_iter=5000, tol=1e-10)) on (A, W1, W2); on partially_exceptional the same six products and A (W1 - 0.2)_+

laws.non_exceptional: RM30 law, blip 0.1 + W1; n = 2000; known g: primary and interval_calibration (SE x 0.80 and noise controls); estimated g: estimated_g_report
laws.wrong_limit: blip 3 (W1^2 - 0.5); n = 2500; known g; optimal_target_control: coverage interval upper bound < 0.92
laws.partially_exceptional: blip (W1 - 0.2)_+, zero on W1 <= 0.2; n = 2000; known g; exceptional_law_report

configuration.gate: a law cell gates when its learner's limit has no tie mass (C7), differs from d0 off the tie set on at most 0.001 (C3f), and max_t P(0 < |b0| <= t) / t <= 10.0 (C8, exponent 1); only non_exceptional gates
configuration.variance: V^-2 sum_v n_v^-2 sum_{i in v} D_i^2 of the raw fold curves, uncentred within each fold (JCI App B)
configuration.truth: Psi_d0 = E Qbar0(d0(W), W), d0 = 1{Qbar0(1, W) > Qbar0(0, W)}, by the trapezoid rule on 4001 points of W1 for each W2; one number per law
configuration.regret: per replication: refit each fold's outcome learner on the fit's training rows with the package's fit_on_rows, require the fit's rule on every validation row (rule L4), integrate each fold rule's value by the same rule, and publish rule_value = (1/V) sum_v Psi_{d_v} and regret = Psi_d0 - rule_value; descriptive
configuration.rule_disagreement: the record's share of rows on which the ten fold rules disagree
configuration.oracle_se: sqrt(V^-2 sum_v Var D*(d_v) / n_v) at the fold rules; descriptive
